subject: API-based evidence push & delegated storage mapping for HelioHealth onboarding
messages:
From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@heliohealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: HelioHealth Security <security@heliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding questions — automated evidence delivery?

Hi Rishi,

Quick background: HelioHealth needs to onboard to Vendr and we want to automate evidence delivery to your portal where possible. Our security ops team prefers pushing artifacts via an authenticated API or S3 manifest so we avoid manual uploads for large bundles.

Questions we have:
- Does Redwood/Vendr accept an API-driven push or pre-signed S3 manifests for evidence ingestion?
- What ownership model do you expect for uploaded artifacts (customer-owned bucket vs. Redwood-managed temporary storage)?
- Any preferred manifest schema (fields you require for CAIQ/SIG mapping)?

I attached a small sample manifest and a short CAIQ mapping we maintain. Can you confirm what format will let us programmatically attach SOC 2 artifacts (reports, syslogs, KMS attestation) without manual steps?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick tech call if helpful.

Best,
Maria Ortega
Head of InfoSec Programs
HelioHealth

Attachments: helio_signed_manifest_sample.json (application/json), helio_caiq_mapping_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@heliohealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding questions — automated evidence delivery?

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear note and the sample manifest. Short answer: yes, we can support API-driven evidence ingestion into Vendr with two flavors:

1) Customer-owned S3 manifest + pre-signed object push: you keep artifacts in your bucket and provide a signed manifest + object URLs. We ingest via a controlled pull and register proof-of-possession.
2) Push to Redwood-managed temporary ingest: you POST artifacts to our temporary ingest API; objects live in a TTL'd bucket we manage for processing and then optionally hand back proofs to you.

For HelioHealth I recommend option (1) since your policy team prefers custody. We need:
- a manifest schema (we included an example in the attached spec) with fields: object_key, sha256, artifact_type (soc2, caiq, log), evidence_date, and assertion_id.
- a small integration role that can create pre-signed PUTs (or we can generate presigns if you give us a short-lived access role).

I'll loop in Laura (platform integrator) for the manifest/schema mapping and Ben for procurement/PO questions. Can you confirm whether HelioHealth will provide a dedicated S3 prefix (e.g., s3://hlh-redwood-ingest/manifest-uploads/) and the contact for your infra (IAM role owner)?

Proposed next steps:
- Laura to validate the manifest schema and sample.
- Quick 30-min tech sync (today or tomorrow) to agree on presign flow.
- Procurement: Ben to confirm any required contract addendum for temporary object transfer.

If that works I’ll send a short RFC and the Vendr ingest spec.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_vendr_ingest_spec_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@heliohealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding questions — automated evidence delivery?

Hi Maria — looping in some technical details below and inline answers against your manifest.

On your sample manifest: great shape. A few minor asks we usually enforce for CAIQ mapping ingestion:
- Please include assertion_id that maps back to the CAIQ question id (we have a mapping table, sample attached).
- For SOC2 artifacts, include vendor_report_metadata: {report_period_start, report_period_end, auditor_name}.
- For log bundles: prefer gzipped archives with a manifest entry per file (we validate sha256 per file).

Regarding the S3 prefix: providing a dedicated, write-only prefix is ideal. Example pattern we expect: s3://<customer-bucket>/redwood/vendr-ingest/<timestamp>/
We do not require Redwood to have persistent access; pre-signed PUTs are fine. If Helio wants Redwood to generate presigns, we need an IAM role with sts:AssumeRole for a 1-hour window.

Tech sync: I’m available 30–2pm PT today. If that’s tight, tomorrow 9–11am PT works too.

Laura Bennett
Product Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: helio_caiq_mapping_v2.xlsx (we annotated the mapping in column H)

From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@heliohealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: HelioHealth Security <security@heliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding questions — automated evidence delivery?

Thanks Laura — that matches our expectations. We can provision a write-only prefix: s3://helio-ml-artifacts/redwood-ingest/ and we will emit pre-signed PUTs from our deployment pipeline. For the manifest fields you requested, we can generate them from our artifacts pipeline (should be straightforward).

Infra owner: Daniel Kim (daniel.kim@heliohealth.com). I’ve copied him on this thread and asked him to confirm the bucket policy.

Let’s take the 30–2pm PT slot today. I’ll set up a short call and include Daniel.

—Maria
Head of InfoSec Programs, HelioHealth

If you’d like, I can drop a one-page SOW stub into DocuSign for the API integration work after the tech sync.

Ben Carter
